sentences.text: BB Ships AB is a company registered on 2026-07-28 under the industry code 30110, building of civilian ships and floating structures.
A start-up notification and a board change were both registered on 2026-08-31.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file, and the register confidence for the entry is low.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is on the thesis list, but no public record yet shows technology or growth.
